methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Climate & Energy (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Climate & Energy, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Tobe Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Colby DeWeese and Caleb Lareau that has raised $4.6M to date. The sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers spanning similar technology areas, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints with comparable valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median method.

Stage-progression valuation, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline of $5M, applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-Series A advancement. This method yields an implied post-money valuation of $12M. A peer-median approach was not applicable given the absence of three or more narrow-filtered comparables at identical or adjacent stages within the Climate & Energy sector; broadening to all eight sector peers would introduce excessive variance and reduce analytical precision.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $10M to $13M, with a median of $12M, grounded solely on stage-progression methodology. Key uncertainties include the company's progress toward Series A inflection points, capital efficiency relative to sector norms, and technical validation milestones. The narrow methodological base reflects typical Seed-stage data constraints and underscores that future rounds will benefit from expanded peer comparability.
